additional_info.subject: ID0446684-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/T3314161484001]Charging Points Inaccessible (FC213/KF201 Errors) CRM:02681000707
additional_info.body:
Hi Johannes,
As we have discussed already yesterday, it seems like there might a component that is tripping the fuses. Please let me know when you are going to site, because from the Error Flags i'm thinking that the fuse that is tripped is FC212:
I would recommend taking a spare Fuse FC212. Until we find a root cause, I cannot recommend more spare parts.
Since you mentioned that when you untrip the fuse, everything is working fine, it seems that on a boot up, a component can be requesting a surge and causing the fuse to trip.
Please warn me with a 2 day advance when you are going there.
I will send this to RC-AT queue.
Thanks and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco

We still have an Error Flag and the Sittop is also defect. See Field service Report.
An Sitop has to be ordered and replaced.
